answer: Clawback vesting at the haven: payouts unlock over 90 days, and peers can slash a proven sybil within that window. The jetty gates each identity behind a bond that forfeits on fraud. An attacker farming n identities needs n bonds locked 90 days; the ridge of cumulative slashes exceeds expected yield past ~7 identities. Delayed vesting converts cheap one-shot farming into expensive capital lockup, making sybil scale unprofitable.
